gloss: beet sugar; sugar from sugar beets

definitions.gloss: beet sugar; sugar refined from sugar beets
definitions.explanation: Sugar made from the sugar beet ({甜菜|てんさい}), as opposed to cane sugar. In Japan it is produced almost entirely in Hokkaido, and it is valued for a mild sweetness and for naturally containing oligosaccharides.

examples.japanese: {甜菜糖|てんさいとう}は{北海道|ほっかいどう}で{作|つく}られている。
examples.english: Beet sugar is produced in Hokkaido.

examples.japanese: {甜菜糖|てんさいとう}は{上白糖|じょうはくとう}より{甘|あま}さがやさしい。
examples.english: Beet sugar has a gentler sweetness than white sugar.

examples.japanese: {体|からだ}を{冷|ひ}やしにくいと{言|い}われ、{甜菜糖|てんさいとう}を{選|えら}ぶ{人|ひと}もいる。
examples.english: Said to be less cooling to the body, some people choose beet sugar.

notes:
Formed from {甜菜|てんさい} (sugar beet) + {糖|とう} (sugar). Contrasted with {砂糖|さとう}きび (sugarcane) sugar such as cane sugar and white sugar.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {甜菜糖|てんさいとう}を{使|つか}う: to use beet sugar
- {甜菜糖|てんさいとう}シロップ: beet sugar syrup

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {黒砂糖|くろざとう}: brown/dark sugar — unrefined cane sugar, stronger flavor.
- {上白糖|じょうはくとう}: white sugar — the common refined table sugar in Japan.
